overview: Both are adrenal cortex hormones, but they belong to different classes with very different jobs — stress metabolism versus salt/water balance.
genZNote: Cortisol handles your stress and blood sugar. Aldosterone handles your salt and water levels.

aspects.label: Main Function
aspects.valueA: Raises blood glucose, suppresses immune response, helps the body handle stress.
aspects.valueB: Increases sodium reabsorption and potassium excretion in the kidney, raising blood pressure.

aspects.label: Main Regulator
aspects.valueA: Controlled by ACTH from the anterior pituitary.
aspects.valueB: Controlled mainly by the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system, not ACTH.

overlay.examHighYieldNote: Aldosterone is the key hormone of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS), which regulates blood pressure via sodium and water retention.
overlay.memoryTrick: Cortisol = stress and sugar. Aldosterone = salt (sodium) balance.
overlay.commonMisconception: Cortisol's regulation is not primarily via RAAS like aldosterone — it is controlled through the hypothalamus-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis via ACTH.
